body:
The SET result is bool | str | bytes | None; coerce success to True so the
methods actually return bool, matching the -> bool signature.

subject: fix(prefect-redis): type write_path/awrite_path as -> bool
body:
Both already return the redis SET result (True on success) and the tests assert
that; the -> None annotation was wrong. Address review feedback on #22394.

subject: fix(prefect-redis): preserve redis SET return value in write_path
body:
Addresses review: awrite_path/write_path were dropping redis-py's SET
result (returning None). Restore the return so async callers awaiting
write_path keep getting the boolean status, as before. Add regression tests.

subject: fix(prefect-redis): make RedisDatabase usable as sync result_storage
body:
closes #22393

`RedisDatabase.read_path`/`write_path` were plain `async def`, so core's
sync result persistence (`call_explicitly_sync_block_method`, which passes
`_sync=True`) raised `TypeError` and silently dropped the result — every
cached run was a MISS. Split each into an async `aread_path`/`awrite_path`
plus an `@async_dispatch` sync wrapper, mirroring core's `WritableFileSystem`
blocks (`LocalFileSystem`/`RemoteFileSystem`).

Backward compatible: awaiting `read_path`/`write_path` from async code still
dispatches to the async implementation.
